edges.reason: _transfer reads maxTransactionAmount to enforce buy/sell caps.
_transfer reads maxWallet to enforce wallet cap.
_transfer checks limitsInEffect before applying restrictions.
_transfer checks tradingActive to gate pre-launch transfers.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before swapping.
_transfer checks transferDelayEnabled for anti-bot delay.
_transfer reads and writes _holderLastTransferTimestamp, coupling transfer rights to tx.origin state.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to decide fee and gating exemptions.
_transfer reads _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount to skip caps.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to classify buy/sell.
_transfer compares contract balance against swapTokensAtAmount.
_transfer checks lpBurnEnabled before auto-burning.
_transfer uses lpBurnFrequency in a timestamp condition for auto-burn.
_transfer uses lastLpBurnTime in a timestamp condition for auto-burn.
_transfer keys the transfer-delay delay map on tx.origin, making delay enforcement caller-origin dependent.
tx.origin is written into _holderLastTransferTimestamp as the anti-bot key.
_transfer sets the swapping guard to true around the swapBack call.
The swapping flag controls execution of swapBack during a transfer.
_transfer conditionally invokes autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens.
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH exist.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call to devWallet before completing its own state updates.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call sending the whole balance to marketingWallet.
devWallet address flows into the external ETH call.
marketingWallet address flows into the external ETH call.
ethForDev feeds the value of the external devWallet call.
ethForMarketing contributes to the value sent to marketingWallet.
contractBalance is computed from balances and used in arithmetic that determines swap sizes.
totalTokensToSwap is used as a divisor in fee share arithmetic.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForLiquidity.
swapBack writes tokensForLiquidity back to zero.
ethForLiquidity is forwarded as the value of the addLiquidityETH call.
swapTokensForEth uses the router instance to perform the swap.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router token-to-ETH swap function.
block.timestamp is used directly as the swap deadline, making the call timestamp dependent.
addLiquidity uses the router instance to add liquidity.
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH function.
block.timestamp is used as the liquidity addition deadline.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens overwrites lastLpBurnTime with the current timestamp.
block.timestamp drives LP burn scheduling state updates.
lpBurnFrequency governs how often the automatic burn can trigger.
percentForLPBurn determines the amount of pair tokens burned.
amountToBurn is computed by multiplication/division of balance and percent.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads the pair address for balance and sync.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync() on the Uniswap pair.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens updates lastManualLpBurnTime with the current timestamp.
manualBurnFrequency gates the manual burn cooldown.
block.timestamp is compared against the manual burn cooldown.
percent parameter controls the manual burn amount.
amountToBurn is computed from pair balance and percent in the manual burn.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads the pair address to burn and sync.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync() on the Uniswap pair.
enableTrading sets tradingActive to true.
enableTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
enableTrading initializes lastLpBurnTime from the current timestamp.
block.timestamp is used to seed the LP burn schedule on enabling trading.
removeLimits sets limitsInEffect to false.
newNum parameter feeds arithmetic that resets maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount using scaling multiplication.
_frequencyInSeconds parameter sets the LP burn frequency.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnFrequency.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnEnabled.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes percentForLPBurn.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping.
updateMarketingWallet writes marketingWallet.
updateDevWallet writes devWallet.
excludeFromFees writes the _isExcludedFromFees mapping.
onlyOwner gating on enableTrading depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gating on updateMaxTxnAmount depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gating on setAutoLPBurnSettings depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gating on updateMarketingWallet depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gating on updateDevWallet depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gating on excludeFromFees depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gating on removeLimits depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gating on manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens depends on msg.sender.
msg.sender indirectly reaches _transfer through ERC20 transfer entry points.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter newNum exists only to compute maxTransactionAmount inside updateMaxTxnAmount, so it normalizes into that function node.
percent is a local argument used solely to compute the burn amount inside manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
amountToBurn is a temporary computed within the burn routines and has no independent semantic role.
contractBalance is a local working value of swapBack used only within that function.
totalTokensToSwap is a local aggregate computed and consumed only inside swapBack.
ethForDev exists only to form the value of the external devWallet ETH call.
ethForMarketing exists only to form the value sent to the marketingWallet call.
_frequencyInSeconds is an argument used only to assign lpBurnFrequency inside setAutoLPBurnSettings.
ethForLiquidity is computed solely to fund the addLiquidityETH router call.
